PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LK-INPUT-DATE
                                LK-FORMATTED-DATE
                                LK-RESULT-CODE.

APPLY-DEPOSIT.
           IF LK-TRANSACTION-AMOUNT <= ZERO
               MOVE "02" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
           ELSE
               ADD LK-TRANSACTION-AMOUNT TO LK-ACCOUNT-BALANCE
               IF LK-ACCOUNT-BALANCE > WS-MAX-BALANCE
                   MOVE "03" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
               END-IF
           END-IF.

APPLY-TRANSACTION.
           MOVE "00" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
           EVALUATE LK-TRANSACTION-TYPE
               WHEN "D"
                   PERFORM APPLY-DEPOSIT
               WHEN "W"
                   PERFORM APPLY-WITHDRAWAL
               WHEN OTHER
                   MOVE "01" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
           END-EVALUATE
           GOBACK.

APPLY-WITHDRAWAL.
           IF LK-TRANSACTION-AMOUNT <= ZERO
               MOVE "02" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
           ELSE
               SUBTRACT LK-TRANSACTION-AMOUNT
                   FROM LK-ACCOUNT-BALANCE
               PERFORM CHECK-OVERDRAFT
           END-IF.

VALIDATE-DATE.
           MOVE "00" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
           IF WS-MONTH < 1 OR WS-MONTH > 12
               MOVE "01" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
           ELSE
               IF WS-DAY < 1 OR WS-DAY > 31
                   MOVE "02" TO LK-RESULT-CODE
               END-IF
           END-IF.

MAIN-PROCESS.
           PERFORM OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               PERFORM READ-CUSTOMER
               IF NOT END-OF-FILE
                   PERFORM VALIDATE-CUSTOMER
                   IF VALID-CUSTOMER
                       PERFORM WRITE-VALID-CUSTOMER
                   ELSE
                       PERFORM WRITE-ERROR-CUSTOMER
                   END-IF
               END-IF
           END-PERFORM
           PERFORM CLOSE-FILES
           GOBACK.

FORMAT-DATE.
           MOVE LK-INPUT-DATE(1:4) TO WS-YEAR
           MOVE LK-INPUT-DATE(5:2) TO WS-MONTH
           MOVE LK-INPUT-DATE(7:2) TO WS-DAY
           PERFORM VALIDATE-DATE
           IF LK-RESULT-CODE = "00"
               STRING WS-YEAR "-" WS-MONTH "-" WS-DAY
                   DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO LK-FORMATTED-DATE
               END-STRING
           ELSE
               MOVE SPACES TO LK-FORMATTED-DATE
           END-IF
           GOBACK.
